exposure: Cervical dilation at time of Cesarean section
outcome: Location of Cesarean section scar in relation to the internal cervical os
Presence of a Cesarean section scar niche
cohort: 407 pregnant women undergoing their first Cesarean section at term
finding: Prelabor and early-labor Cesarean delivery were associated with an increased prevalence of a Cesarean section scar located in the uterine cavity and the presence of a scar niche.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery in late labor is associated with the uterine scar being situated in the endocervical canal and with a lower incidence of a niche.
